children.name: Bryum argenteum
children.description: Bryum argenteum, the silvergreen bryum moss or silvery thread moss, is a species of moss in the family Bryaceae.

children.name: Bryum dixonii
children.description: Bryum dixonii, commonly known as Dixon's threadmoss, is a moss endemic to Scotland.

children.description: Anomobryum julaceum, the slender silver-moss, is a species of bryophyte native to all continents except South America and Antarctica.

children.name: Rhodobryum roseum
children.description: Rhodobryum roseum, commonly known as rose moss, is a species of moss of the subclass Bryidae and family Bryaceae, found throughout most of the world in woods or sheltered grassy places.
